decisions.statement: A kind of file names its handler in a record rather than in a chain of branches.
A kind of file the record names no handler for is refused by the compiler.
An import operation takes the name the run-observing table gives that operation.
The signed-in reader is handed in by the caller.
Every import and export function a handler calls may be handed in by the caller.
Where the source file sits may be handed in rather than read off the watcher config.
The characters export is held back where a characters import is not synced.
The inventory import finishes before the settings export starts.
An export that throws fails its own operation alone, carrying what it said, and writes no side file.
The companions import runs beside the companion-builds export.
The characters file is written back nowhere.
A run with no operation is reported nowhere.
A throw comes back as a result carrying the message rather than reaching the caller.
The account a run is reported under is read from the signed-in reader.
Nothing here names the kinds of file the watcher knows.
Nothing here exports the type naming a kind of file.
Nothing here reaches for a shared signed-in reader.

definition: which imports and exports one kind of saved-variables file is carried across by
